pick.headline: NATO London Declaration offers the East a hand of friendship

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report Supplement: Soviet Union, 28th CPSU Congress, 9 July 1990
evidence.snippet: …ormation. As they state, the emphasis on the purely military aspect is being reduced. They intend to change their strategy—this is an official statement. What else do they say? It is necessary to [be] prepared to sign a declaration and state that the two alliances are no longer enemies and will refrain from threats or the use of force. NATO has expressed readi- ness to quickly complete the negotiations in progress in Vienna on conventional armamen…
